question: Why is buddhi-based insight primary even in initiation?
premises: Its liberating power depends on being preceded by buddhi-based insight.
What makes initiation effective has primacy in that context.
inference: Therefore even in initiation, buddhi-based knowledge has primacy.
plain_english: Initiation truly liberates when it is preceded by buddhi-based insight. For that reason, even in initiation, buddhi-based knowledge holds the primary place.
